title: 烏帽子と矛の先導
desc: 巻頭の右端、烏帽子を被り長大な矛を手にした青鬼を先頭に、先駆けの小鬼たちが露払いとなって夜行の口火を切る。
descen: At the opening of the scroll on the far right, a blue demon wearing an eboshi cap and grasping a massive spear leads the vanguard, accompanied by swift small imps acting as path-clearers to kick off the night parade.
titleen: Vanguard with Eboshi Cap and Spear

title: 大布・赤塊と槌の妖怪
desc: 大きな布を被った妖怪の前を、赤く丸い肉塊のような妖怪が這うように進む。その背後からは槌を振り上げた異形の妖怪が迫り、今まさに打ちかからんとしている。
descen: In front of a yokai veiled in a large cloth, a red, rounded lump-like apparition crawls along the ground. From behind, a bizarre creature brandishing a wooden mallet bears down, poised to strike.
titleen: Veiled Yokai, Red Mass, and the Mallet-Wielder

title: 女房の化粧と袋持ち
desc: 大きな袋を担いだ妖怪の視線の先では、物陰に集まった女房姿の妖怪たちが、鏡を覗き込みお歯黒をつけて身づくろいに余念がない。幕の陰からは、その様子を楽しげに窺う女型の妖怪も描かれる。
descen: Ahead of a yokai carrying a large sack over its shoulder, court lady yokai gathered in the shadows diligently groom themselves, peering into mirrors to apply black tooth dye (ohaguro). From behind a curtain, a female-form yokai is depicted curiously and playfully peeking out at them.
titleen: Court Ladies' Toilette and the Sack Carrier

title: 楽器・法具の器物妖怪
desc: 命を宿した鰐口や払子などの仏具・法具の妖怪たちが練り歩き、その前方では沓（履物）の妖怪や、琴を従えた琵琶の妖怪が行列を先導する。
descen: Buddhist and ritual tsukumogami brought to life—such as temple gongs (waniguchi) and fly-whisks (hossu)—march in parade, led forward by a shoe (kutsu) yokai and an animated biwa lute accompanied by a koto zither.

title: 法具・台所道具の器物妖怪
desc: 鳥兜の妖怪が宙を舞い、鍋蓋や釜といった台所道具の化物たちがひしめき合う。巻物を広げる妖怪の前には、楽器の銅拍子（どうびょうし）の妖怪が先陣を切って進む。
descen: A torikabuto court dancer's cap yokai soars through the air as animated kitchen implements like pot lids and iron cauldrons crowd together. Ahead of a yokai unfurling a handscroll, a pair of animated cymbals (dobyoshi) leads the advance.

title: 道中・身回りの器物妖怪
desc: 如意や扇子の妖怪の前に、再び大きな布を被った妖怪が現れて隊列を遮る。その騒ぎを、草鞋や傘の妖怪たちが脇から見守っている。
descen: Before tsukumogami of ceremonial scepters (nyoi) and folding fans, a creature veiled in a large cloth appears once more to block the procession, while straw sandal and umbrella yokai look on from the side.

title: 唐櫃から逃げる妖怪
desc: 恐ろしい赤鬼に脅かされ、唐櫃（からびつ）の中に隠れていた五徳や釜などの器物妖怪たちが、蓋を押し開けて一斉に飛び出し逃げ惑う。
descen: Frightened by a fearsome red demon, household tsukumogami such as trivets (gotoku) and cauldrons hiding inside a storage chest (karabitsu) push open the lid and scatter in terrified flight.

title: 古葛籠の上の妖怪
desc: 大きな古葛籠（ふるつづら）の周囲を、鋏（はさみ）の妖怪をはじめとする無数の異形たちが這い回り、百鬼夜行の狂乱は最高潮に達する。
descen: Countless bizarre creatures, led by a pair of shears (hasami) yokai, clamber around a massive antique storage basket (tsuzura), driving the nighttime frenzy to its fever pitch.
titleen: Yokai around the Antique Tsuzura Basket

title: 火の玉と退散
desc: 立ち込める暗雲を切り裂くように真っ赤な火の玉（日輪）が出現。夜明けの光に恐れ慄いた妖怪たちは、背後を振り返りながら一目散に逃げ去っていく。
descen: Ripping through the dense dark clouds, a blazing crimson fireball (the rising sun) appears. Overwhelmed with dread at the light of dawn, the yokai cast fearful glances backward as they flee in total disarray.
titleen: The Fireball and the Flight of Yokai
